div.head: Wl ep 4.1
div.ab: Nec aliquis laicus homo alium hominem sine iustitia episcopi ad iudicium adducat.
Nec aliquis laicus homo alium hominem sine iusticia episcopi ad iudicium adducat.
And no layman shall make a man undergo trial by ordeal without the authority of the bishop.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 236–237 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text added from Gesetze I p. 485, October 2026 (two independent readings of the page images)
